basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE original opaque full-bleed 5:7 portrait oil painting revisiting an existing medieval dark-fantasy civilization card scene. Preserve the established subject and warm dark-fantasy themes while redesigning the composition with the narrative clarity of N. C. Wyeth and Dean Cornwell: one decisive action, multiple small faceless figures, a strong sense of scale, broad expressive visible oil brushwork, large quiet value masses and one controlled focal contrast. Early twentieth-century adventure-book painting, not photorealistic or glossy digital fantasy. No discernible human faces; show backs, hoods, or distant silhouettes. Put the focal action and principal figures within the upper 45 percent for small card readability; lower half subdued because UI covers it. Clear at 70x100 pixels. No text, letters, symbols, decorative border, frame, interface, vignette, tiny clutter or unrelated objects. Subject:

assets.cultivate: At least three tiny hooded villagers harvest a great sweeping amber grain field beside one narrow irrigation channel. A pale curved sickle and lifted sheaf in the upper center make one bright focal gesture; the enormous field rolls into distant blue hills. Broad ochre and dark green bands.
assets.raiseHouses: Five small faceless builders cooperate to raise one heavy timber rafter on an earthen house. Two pull a taut rope while others brace the new wall; the pale rafter against a dark sky is the focal diagonal. The structure dwarfs the people, baskets of clay reduced to quiet shapes.
assets.administrate: From a high oblique viewpoint, several tiny anonymous porters coordinate heavy food baskets across the courtyard of a monumental granary. One pale basket passes between hands under a giant arch, the clear focal exchange; roads and supply carts recede in broad geometric bands. No readable writing.
assets.exchange: Under the vast arch of a crowded but subdued old market, two small hooded traders exchange a golden grain sack for a blue clay pot while a third carries goods. The opposing hands and two objects make a crisp focal transaction; distant market stalls collapse into quiet color blocks.
assets.import: Three ox-drawn food carts arrive at a village gate in the mist; several tiny hooded villagers unload one prominent pale grain sack from the lead cart. Immense gateway and road set scale, lantern glow isolates the sack and joined hands. Grey-blue distance, warm umber foreground.
assets.mixedFarming: A panoramic patchwork farm in a tall composition: three small faceless villagers tend adjacent vegetable beds, orchard trees, and amber grain strips. One worker lifts a basket from the boundary between crops, the focal action. The alternating broad green and gold field bands stretch across hills.
assets.efficientKitchens: In a vast communal kitchen under a high dark roof, three small hooded cooks cooperate around one oversized copper pot. One lifts a ladle pouring pale broth into a waiting bowl, the only bright focal arc. Stone ovens and vegetables stay broad low-contrast masses.
assets.homesteading: Several tiny faceless families establish a hillside village beneath a large sky: one pair places a roof beam onto a new reed-roof cottage while others carry baskets along a footpath. The pale beam and new dwelling are focal; terraced plots and distant huts convey a growing settlement.
assets.study: Three hooded scholars seen from behind consult one immense open book beneath a towering library window. One points with a thin wooden rod to a broad blank diagram, the ivory page and hand the focus. Shelves and arches form quiet dark scale, no legible marks.
assets.mill: An enormous riverside watermill turns above a dark stream as three tiny workers carry grain sacks across its bridge. The foaming white water striking the great wheel is focal; millhouse and cliff are large silhouettes. Warm stone, slate water and quiet lower bank.
assets.harvestFestival: At dusk in a vast village square, many small hooded villagers circle one towering bound grain sheaf and a long table of bread. Three foreground figures lift a single golden loaf together in celebration, the focal gesture. Lamps glow softly, architecture broad shadow masses, no faces.
assets.marketFeast: Under a huge market canopy, three small faceless villagers pass one bright platter of bread and fruit across a communal table. More seated silhouettes recede but remain simple, monumental square and warm lamps show scale. The shared platter and hands are the only sharp contrast.
assets.symposium: Six small hooded craftspeople from different trades gather around a great circular stone table in an immense courtyard. Three nearest exchange a pot, wooden tool, and open blank manuscript across the center; the illuminated shared page is focal. Columns and other tools subdued.
assets.vigil: At a vast ancient stone shrine at night, several tiny cloaked villagers keep watch around one great brass brazier. Three closest figures lean inward to light a candle from its flame; the flame and hands are focal. Deep blue-black arches and distant candles form quiet scale.
